name: Trusts Identity Source
description: An IAM Identity Center instance takes its workforce users from an external identity provider: AWS calls this the instance's identity source, and the instance accepts SAML 2.0 assertions from it (instance -> provider). The target is WILDCARD (omitted) because the provider is another plugin's node, most often an Okta application, and aws_core declares no dependency on any identity plugin. It is not identity_core's oidc_issuer either: Identity Center federates over SAML, not OIDC. An instance using its own identity store or Active Directory has no edge of this type.
